page.overview:
Who is Arakki?

is the orcish leader of the Koshtask clan of the Iothia Moorland between 835 PD and 855 PD.

Arakki was described in 835 PD as a fire-scarred orc. By 855 PD he looked like a mature man of tanned, age-marked skin with scars, black eyes and long black hair. He is corpulent and wears armor.

Arakki was a cunning and strategic leader who made alliances to ensure his clan's survival, but being able to betray and destroy those same allies without hesitation. He's devout of the Ruiner, and he actively asked for his forgiveness before accepting the faith of the Kryn Dynasty.

Arakki was the leader of his clan for at least two decades, between 835 and 855 PD. During that time, he tried to keep Koshtask independence against the Kryn Dynasty and the cult of the First Radiance with its increasing popularity in Xhorhas; due to this, Arakki was hostile towards missionaries of the Luxon.
